propositions: The rebar package must declare s3 as an optional dependency in pyproject.toml with constraint git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 to keep core dependencies lean.

A require_s3_helper() function must probe both PATH availability of the git-remote-s3 console script and the installed distribution version to ensure the helper is present and meets the 0.3.2 minimum required for IfNoneMatch lock support.
The version comparison logic must parse semantic versions in pure stdlib without external packages, treating unparseable or too-old versions as failures.
The s3 optional extra must integrate into _optional.py's existing EXTRAS and guard_import pattern to surface consistent user-facing install hints via pip install nava-rebar[s3].

Unit tests must validate require_s3_helper() success/failure across seven scenarios: presence+sufficient version, missing script, missing distribution metadata, version too old, version newer/suffixed, unparseable version, and guard_import integration.
